description: This file defines the 'Details' feature for user information retrieval, including a query, validator, and handler to fetch user details and generate a JWT token.

classes.name: Details
classes.description: Contains nested classes for the user details feature including query, validator, and handler.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Represents the request to get user details based on username.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates the Query object ensuring the Username is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the query by fetching user data from the database, generating a JWT token, and returning user info encapsulated in UserEnvelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the main logic to retrieve user data by username, handle not found errors, map data, generate token, and return the user envelope.
